units.literal: Merit affairs also cost little: one melon into dozens of kinds, one dish into dozens of flavors; without changing melon or vegetable there are not many kinds—because of variety, what harm to affairs? It touches the state not in the least.

units.zh: 如得財如法而用，此不愧乎人。
units.en: Wealth lawfully gained and lawfully spent is nothing to be ashamed of.
units.literal: To obtain wealth and use it lawfully—this is no shame before men.

units.zh: 我自除公宴，不食國家之食，多歷年稔，乃至宮人，亦不食國家之食，積累歲月。
units.en: Apart from state banquets I have not eaten public rations for many years, and even the palace women have gone without them for a long time.
units.literal: I myself, apart from public feasts, do not eat the state's food—many years; even palace women do not eat state food—months piled up.

units.zh: 凡所營造，不關材官，及以國匠，皆資雇借，以成其事。
units.en: Every building project avoids the materials bureau and state craftsmen. I hire labor and pay for the work myself.
units.literal: All construction does not involve the materials office or state artisans—all is hired on loan to complete the work.

units.zh: 近之得財，頗有方便，民得其利，國得其利，我得其利，營諸功德。
units.en: Money lately raised has served everyone: the people profit, the state profits, I profit, and merit works are funded.
units.literal: Recent income has had convenient paths—the people gain, the state gains, I gain, and merit works are built.

units.zh: 或以卿之心度我之心，故不能得知。
units.en: Perhaps you judge me by yourself, and that is why you do not understand.
units.literal: Perhaps you measure my heart by your heart and therefore cannot know.

units.zh: 所得財用，暴於天下，不得曲辭辯論。
units.en: What I receive is open to the world. Do not argue in evasions.
units.literal: Income obtained is displayed to the realm—no twisting words in debate.

units.zh: 卿又云女妓越濫，此有司之責，雖然，亦有不同：貴者多畜妓樂，至於勳附若兩掖，亦復不聞家有二八，多畜女妓者。
units.en: You also complain that courtesans are too many. That is the censors' business, though the cases differ. The great mostly keep musicians, but even meritorious lords and the two palace wings—one seldom hears of a household keeping "two-eight" girls or hoarding courtesans.
units.literal: You also say female entertainers overflow—this is the responsible officials' duty; still there are differences: the noble mostly keep music girls, but even merit lords and the two flanks—one does not hear of households with "two-eight," or of many keeping female entertainers.

units.zh: 此並宜具言其人，當令有司振其霜豪。
units.en: Name every offender. Let the responsible offices strip away their arrogance.
units.literal: These should all be named; let the offices shake off their frost and pride.

units.zh: 卿又云：「乃追恨所取爲少，如復傅翼，增其搏噬，一何悖哉。」
units.en: You also wrote: "They regret having taken too little, and if given wings again they tear all the harder—how perverse!"
units.literal: You also say: "Yet they regret what they took was little; if given wings again, increasing their tearing and devouring—how perverse!"

units.zh: 勇怯不同，貪廉各用，勇者可使進取，怯者可使守城，貪者可使捍禦，廉者可使牧民。
units.en: Courage and cowardice are not the same, nor are greed and integrity. Use the brave for advance, the timid for defense, the greedy for the border, the honest for civil rule.
units.literal: Bravery and timidity differ; greed and integrity each have their use—the brave may be sent to attack, the timid to hold cities, the greedy to defend the frontier, the upright to rule the people.

units.zh: 向使叔齊守于西河，豈能濟事？
units.en: If Shu Qi alone had held the western river, would anything have been accomplished?
units.literal: Had Shu Qi alone guarded the western river, could the affair have succeeded?

units.zh: 吳起育民，必無成功。
units.en: If Wu Qi had only nurtured the people, he would never have succeeded.
units.literal: Wu Qi nurturing the people would surely have had no success.

units.zh: 若使吳起而不重用，則西河之功廢。
units.en: Had Wu Qi not been used as he deserved, the western river would never have been won.
units.literal: If Wu Qi had not been heavily employed, the achievement at the western river would have been wasted.

units.zh: 今之文武，亦復如此。
units.en: The same is true of civil and military men today.
units.literal: Today's civil and military officers are likewise.

units.zh: 取其搏噬之用，不能得不重更任，彼亦非爲朝廷爲之傅翼。
units.en: Use their predatory talents and you cannot avoid employing them heavily again. The court did not give them wings so they could prey harder.
units.literal: Take their tearing and devouring use—they cannot but be heavily employed again; the court did not give them wings for that purpose.

units.zh: 卿以朝廷爲悖，乃自甘之，當思致悖所以。
units.en: You call the court perverse yet still serve it willingly. Ask yourself what makes it perverse.
units.literal: You call the court perverse yet willingly serve it—you should consider what makes perversity.

units.zh: 卿云「宜導之以節儉」。
units.en: You say, "They should be guided by frugality."
units.literal: You say, "One should guide them with thrift."

units.zh: 又云「至治者必以淳素爲先」。
units.en: And, "Perfect government begins in plain simplicity."
units.literal: And, "Supreme rule must take plain simplicity first."

units.zh: 此言大善。
units.en: That is well said.
units.literal: These words are very fine.

units.zh: 夫子言「其身正，不令而行；
units.en: Confucius said, "When the ruler's person is upright, things are done though he does not command;
units.literal: The Master said, "If his person is upright, without being ordered it is done;

units.zh: 其身不正，雖令不從」。
units.en: when his person is not upright, they will not obey though he commands."
units.literal: if his person is not upright, though ordered they do not follow."

units.zh: 朕絕房室三十餘年，無有淫佚。
units.en: I have kept no harem for more than thirty years and have known no debauchery.
units.literal: I have cut off the inner chambers for thirty-odd years—no licentiousness.

units.zh: 朕頗自計，不與女人同屋而寢，亦三十餘年。
units.en: By my own reckoning I have not slept in the same room with a woman for more than thirty years.
units.literal: I count myself: not sleeping in the same room with women—also thirty-odd years.

units.zh: 至於居處不過一床之地，雕飾之物不入于宮，此亦人所共知。
units.en: My living space is no larger than a bed. Ornament does not enter the palace. Everyone knows this.
units.literal: My dwelling is no more than one bed's space; carved ornament never enters the palace—this too all know.

units.zh: 受生不飲酒，受生不好音聲，所以朝中曲宴，未嘗奏樂，此羣賢之所觀見。
units.en: I have never drunk and never cared for music, so at court gatherings no instruments are played. The ministers have seen it themselves.
units.literal: Since birth I do not drink; since birth I dislike sound—so at court informal feasts music is never played; the worthies have seen this.

units.zh: 朕三更出理事，隨事多少，事少或中前得竟，或事多至日昃方得就食。
units.en: I rise in the deep night to work. When business is light I may finish before noon. When it is heavy I eat only after the sun has slanted west.
units.literal: I rise at the third watch to handle affairs; as affairs vary—few affairs and I may finish before noon; many affairs and only at sundown may I eat.

units.zh: 日常一食，若晝若夜，無有定時。
units.en: As a rule I eat once, by day or night, at no set time.
units.literal: Usually one meal, day or night, at no fixed hour.

units.zh: 疾苦之日，或亦再食。
units.en: When I am ill I may eat twice.
units.literal: On days of illness, sometimes two meals.

units.zh: 昔要腹過於十圍，今之瘦削裁二尺餘，舊帶猶存，非爲妄說。
units.en: Once my belly measured more than ten spans around. Now I am scarcely two feet about the waist. The old belt is still here. I do not lie.
units.literal: Once my waist was more than ten girths; now I am wasted to barely two feet odd—the old belt still kept; this is no empty claim.

units.zh: 爲誰爲之？
units.en: For whom did I do this?
units.literal: For whom was it done?

units.zh: 救物故也。
units.en: For the sake of the living—that is why.
units.literal: To save the creatures—that is why.

units.zh: 《書》曰：「股肱惟人，良臣惟聖。」
units.en: The Documents say, "Arms and legs are the man; worthy ministers make the sage."
units.literal: The Documents say, "Limbs and arms are the man; good ministers make the sage."

units.zh: 向使朕有股肱，故可得中主。
units.en: Had I such ministers, I might have been a passable ruler.
units.literal: Had I such limbs and arms, I could have been a middling lord.

units.zh: 今乃不免居九品之下，「不令而行」，徒虛言耳。
units.en: As it is I remain no better than the lowest grade of ruler. "Without being ordered it is done" is only an empty phrase.
units.literal: Now I still cannot rise above the ninth grade—"without being ordered it is done" is only empty words.

units.zh: 卿今慊言，便罔知所答。
units.en: You press your case so hard that I scarcely know how to reply.
units.literal: You now speak fully—at once I do not know what to answer.

units.zh: 卿又云「百司莫不奏事，詭競求進」。
units.en: You also say, "Every office memorializes, scheming for promotion."
units.literal: You also say, "The hundred offices all memorialize, deviously competing for advancement."

units.zh: 此又是誰？
units.en: Who are they? Name them.
units.literal: Who are these again?

units.zh: 何者復是詭事？
units.en: Which are these deceptive affairs again?
units.literal: Which affairs again are the deceptive matters?

units.zh: 今不使外人呈事，於義可否？
units.en: If outsiders may no longer present memorials, is that right in principle?
units.literal: Now not to let outsiders present affairs—in principle is that permissible?

units.zh: 無人廢職，職可廢乎？
units.en: No men, no offices—can you abolish the offices themselves?
units.literal: Without men offices are abandoned—can offices be abandoned?

units.zh: 職廢則人亂，人亂則國安乎？
units.en: Abolish offices and men fall into disorder; men in disorder—and the realm is secure?
units.literal: Offices abandoned, then men are confused; men confused, then is the state at peace?

units.zh: 以咽廢飧，此之謂也。
units.en: Reject the meal because the throat hurts—that is the case.
units.literal: To reject food because of the throat—this is what is meant.

units.zh: 若斷呈事，誰屍其任？
units.en: Cut off memorials—who then answers for the charge?
units.literal: If presenting affairs is cut off, who bears the responsibility?

units.zh: 專委之人，云何可得？
units.en: Where will you find men fit to be trusted with everything alone?
units.literal: Men exclusively entrusted—how can they be obtained?

units.zh: 是故古人云：「專聽生姦，獨任成亂。」
units.en: The ancients said it plainly: "Listen to one voice and treachery is born; trust one man alone and chaos follows."
units.literal: Therefore the ancients said: "Exclusive listening breeds treachery; sole trust breeds chaos."

units.zh: 猶二世之委趙高，元後之付王莽。
units.en: Think of Er Shi handing everything to Zhao Gao, or Empress Yuan giving the realm to Wang Mang.
units.literal: Just as Er Shi entrusted Zhao Gao, and Empress Yuan entrusted Wang Mang.

units.zh: 呼鹿爲馬，卒有閻樂望夷之禍，王莽亦終移漢鼎。
units.en: Call a deer a horse, and in the end Yan Le brings ruin at Wangyi; Wang Mang too shifts the Han throne from its base.
units.literal: Calling a deer a horse—in the end came the disaster of Yan Le at Wangyi; Wang Mang also finally moved the tripod of Han.

units.zh: 卿云「吹毛求疵」，復是何人所吹之疵？
units.en: You wrote "splitting hairs for flaws"—whose flaws? Name him.
units.literal: You say "splitting hairs for flaws"—again, whose flaws are being split?

units.zh: 「擘肌分理」，復是何人乎？
units.en: "Splitting muscle to distinguish principle"—who is that?
units.literal: "Splitting muscle to distinguish principle"—again, who is it?

units.zh: 事及「深刻」「繩逐」，並復是誰？
units.en: When you speak of "severity" and "driving by the cord," who are they?
units.literal: Matters touching "severity" and "driving by the cord"—again, who are they?

units.zh: 又云「治、署、邸、肆」，何者宜除？
units.en: You also named "bureaus, offices, lodges, markets"—which should be abolished?
units.literal: You also say "administration, offices, lodges, markets"—which ought to be abolished?

units.zh: 何者宜省？
units.en: Which should be cut?
units.literal: Which ought to be reduced?

units.zh: 「國容戎備」，何者宜省？
units.en: "State ceremony and armaments"—what should be trimmed?
units.literal: "State display and military preparedness"—which ought to be reduced?

units.zh: 何者未須？
units.en: What is not needed now?
units.literal: Which are not yet needed?

units.zh: 「四方屯傳」，何者無益？
units.en: "Garrisons and relays in all four quarters"—which do no good?
units.literal: "Relay posts in all four quarters"—which are useless?

units.zh: 何者妨民？
units.en: Which harm the people?
units.literal: Which harm the people?

units.zh: 何處興造而是役民？
units.en: Where do you build at the cost of forced labor?
units.literal: Where is construction that conscripts the people?

units.zh: 何處費財而是非急？
units.en: Where is treasure spent on what is not urgent?
units.literal: Where is wealth spent on what is not urgent?

units.zh: 若爲「討召」？
units.en: What of "summons and recruitment"?
units.literal: As for "summons and recruitment"?

units.zh: 若爲「征賦」？
units.en: What of "levies and requisitions"?
units.literal: As for "levies and requisitions"?

units.zh: 朝廷從來無有此事，靜息之方復何者？
units.en: The court has never done such things. What is your plan to bring them to rest?
units.literal: The court has never had such matters from the beginning—what methods quiet and rest them?

units.zh: 宜各出其事，具以奏聞。
units.en: Let each charge be named and reported in full.
units.literal: Each should state the affair and memorialize it in full.

units.zh: 卿云「若不及于時大息其民，事至方圖，知無及也」。
units.en: You wrote, "Fail now to give the people real rest, and plan only when crisis comes—you will know you are already too late."
units.literal: You say, "If one does not at this time greatly rest the people, and only plans when the affair has arrived, one knows it will be too late."

units.zh: 如卿此言，卽時便是大役其民，是何處所？
units.en: By your own logic you are overworking the people right now—where?
units.literal: By your words, at this very moment you are greatly overworking the people—where is that?

units.zh: 卿云「國弊民疲」，誠如卿言，終須出其事，不得空作漫語。
units.en: You say "the realm is hollow and the people exhausted." If that is so, name the facts. Do not speak in empty generalities.
units.literal: You say "the state is spent and the people weary"—if it is truly as you say, in the end you must state the affairs; you cannot make empty, roaming words.

units.zh: 夫能言之，必能行之。
units.en: Who can talk must also act.
units.literal: One who can speak of it must be able to carry it out.

units.zh: 富國強兵之術，急民省役之宜，號令遠近之法，並宜具列。
units.en: Ways to enrich the state and strengthen the army, plans to spare the people and cut corvée, orders for near and far—list them all.
units.literal: Methods to enrich the state and strengthen the army, measures urgent for resting the people and reducing corvée, commands for the near and far—all should be listed in full.

units.zh: 若不具列，則是欺罔朝廷，空示頰舌。
units.en: Fail to list them and you deceive the throne with nothing but lip service.
units.literal: If you do not list them in full, then you are deceiving the court and showing only cheek and tongue.

units.zh: 凡人有爲，先須內省，惟無瑕者，可以戮人。
units.en: Before you judge others, judge yourself. Only the spotless may sit in judgment.
units.literal: Whenever a man would act, he must first look inward; only one without flaw may punish others.

units.zh: 卿不得曆詆內外，而不極言其事。
units.en: You may not slander everyone within and without the palace and still refuse to speak plainly.
units.literal: You may not go through the court inside and out with slander and not speak to the utmost of the affairs.

units.zh: 佇聞重奏，當復省覽，付之尚書，班下海內，庶亂羊永除，害馬長息，惟新之美，復見今日。
units.en: I await your next memorial. I shall read it again, send it to the Masters of Writing, and publish it throughout the realm—so the bad sheep are driven off, the harmful horse stilled, and renewal shines once more.
units.literal: I await hearing your further memorial; I shall again examine it, entrust it to the Masters of Writing, and promulgate it within the four seas—so that bad sheep may be forever removed, harmful horses long stilled, and the beauty of renewal appear again today.

units.zh: 琛奉敕，但謝過而已，不敢復有指斥。
units.en: Chen took the edict and could only apologize. He did not dare remonstrate again.
units.literal: Chen received the edict and only apologized, not daring to criticize again.

units.zh: 久之，遷太府卿。
units.en: In time he was made Minister of the Grand Treasury.
units.literal: After a long while he was transferred to Minister of the Grand Treasury.

units.zh: 太清二年，遷雲騎將軍、中軍宣城王長史。
units.en: In the second year of Taiqing he became General of the Cloud Cavalry and chief clerk to the Prince of Xuancheng, commander of the central army.
units.literal: In the second year of Taiqing he was transferred to General of the Cloud Cavalry and Chief Clerk to the Prince of Xuancheng, Commander of the Central Army.

units.zh: 侯景舉兵襲京師，王移入臺內，留琛與司馬楊曒守東府。
units.en: When Hou Jing marched on the capital the prince withdrew into the inner palace and left Chen and Marshal Yang Xun to defend the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: Hou Jing raised troops and struck the capital; the prince moved into the inner palace, leaving Chen and the marshal Yang Xun to hold the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 賊尋攻陷城，放兵殺害，琛被槍未至死，賊求得之，轝至闕下，求見僕射王克、領軍朱异，勸開城納賊。
units.en: The rebels soon broke the city and unleashed slaughter. Chen was speared but lived. They found him, bore him in a litter to the palace gate, and demanded Wang Ke, Vice Director, and Zhu Yi, Commander of the Army, begging them to open the gates to the rebels.
units.literal: The rebels soon stormed the city, let their soldiers slaughter, and Chen was speared but not killed; the rebels found him, carried him in a litter to the palace gate, and sought audience with Vice Director Wang Ke and Commander of the Army Zhu Yi, urging them to open the city and admit the rebels.

units.zh: 克等讓之，涕泣而止，賊復轝送莊嚴寺療治之。
units.en: Wang Ke and the others reproached him until he wept and fell silent. The rebels carried him back to Zhuangyan Monastery to heal his wounds.
units.literal: Ke and the others rebuked him; weeping, he stopped, and the rebels again carried him in a litter to Zhuangyan Monastery for treatment.

units.zh: 明年，臺城不守，琛逃歸鄉里。
units.en: The next year the inner city fell. Chen fled to his home district.
units.literal: The next year the inner city could not be held; Chen fled home to his native place.

units.zh: 其年冬，賊進寇會稽，復執琛送出都，以爲金紫光祿大夫。
units.en: That winter, when the rebels marched on Kuaiji, they seized Chen again and sent him to the capital as Household Counsellor with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
units.literal: That winter the rebels advanced against Kuaiji, seized Chen again, and sent him back to the capital, making him Household Counsellor with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

units.zh: 後遇疾卒，年六十九。
units.en: He later fell ill and died at sixty-nine.
units.literal: Later he fell ill and died, aged sixty-nine.

units.zh: 琛所撰《三禮講疏》、《五經滯義》及諸儀法，凡百餘篇。
units.en: He wrote the Exegesis of the Three Rites, the Stalled Meanings of the Five Classics, and many works on ritual—over a hundred chapters in all.
units.literal: Chen compiled the Exegesis of the Three Rites, the Stalled Meanings of the Five Classics, and various ritual regulations—more than a hundred chapters in all.

units.zh: 子詡，太清初，自儀同西昌侯掾，出爲巴山太守，在郡遇亂卒。
units.en: His son Xu, early in Taiqing, left a post as aide to the Marquis of Xichang, Equal in Rank to the Three Dukes, to serve as Administrator of Bashan, and died there when rebellion swept the region.
units.literal: His son Xu, at the beginning of Taiqing, rose from aide to the Marquis of Xichang, Equal in Rank to the Three Dukes, and went out as Administrator of Bashan; in the commandery he met with the chaos and died.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察云：夏侯勝有言曰：「士患不明經術；
units.en: Yao Cha, Chen Director of the Ministry of Personnel, said: Xiahou Sheng once said, "The scholar's trouble is not knowing the classics;
units.literal: Yao Cha, Chen Director of the Ministry of Personnel, said: Xia Hou Sheng had a saying: "The gentleman's trouble is not knowing the classics;

units.zh: 經術明，取青紫如拾地芥耳。」
units.en: Once the classics are clear, rank and office are like picking up a mustard plant from the ground."
units.literal: once the classics are clear, taking blue and purple is like picking up a mustard plant from the ground."

units.zh: 朱异、賀琛並起微賤，以經術逢時，致於貴顯，符其言矣。
units.en: Zhu Yi and He Chen both rose from humble beginnings; the classics brought them to high rank in their day—exactly as he said.
units.literal: Zhu Yi and He Chen both rose from humble beginnings; by the classics they met their time and reached noble eminence—this matched his words.

units.zh: 而异遂徼寵倖，任事居權，不能以道佐君，苟取容媚。
units.en: Yet Yi sought favor and power, held office, and could not guide his lord by the Way—only by pleasing and flattering.
units.literal: Yet Yi went on to seek favor and fortune, hold office and wield power, and could not assist his lord by the Way but only sought to please and flatter.

units.zh: 及延寇敗國，實异之由。
units.en: When the rebel ravaged the realm, the blame was truly Yi's.
units.literal: When the rebel prolonged his ravaging of the state, the fault was truly Yi's.

units.zh: 禍難旣彰，不明其罪，至於身死，寵贈猶殊。
units.en: Once disaster was plain his guilt went unnamed; even in death his honors were lavish.
units.literal: Once disaster was plain, his guilt was not made clear; even at his death, favors and gifts were still extraordinary.

units.zh: 罰旣弗加，賞亦斯濫，失於勸沮，何以爲國？
units.en: No punishment fell, rewards ran wild—how can a state encourage good and restrain evil like this?
units.literal: Punishment was not applied, reward likewise ran wild—failure in encouragement and restraint; how can such a thing be called a state?

units.zh: 君子是以知太清之亂，能無及是乎。
units.en: A gentleman therefore knows that the chaos of Taiqing could not have stopped short of this.
units.literal: The gentleman therefore knows that the chaos of Taiqing could not fail to reach this.

units.zh: 伏願陛下哀忠念舊，愛孤恤寡，矜愚嘉善，舍過記功，敦骨肉之情，廣寬仁之路，思堯、舜之風，慕禹、湯之德，克己復禮，以成美化，天下幸甚。」
units.en: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."
units.literal: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual, to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."

units.zh: 孝文皇帝，高祖中子也，母曰薄姬。
units.en: Emperor Xiaowen was the middle son of Emperor Gaozu, born to Lady Bo.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowen was Gaozu's middle son, his mother was named Lady Bo.

units.zh: 贊曰：孝文皇帝即位二十三年，宮室苑囿車騎服御無所增益。
units.en: The commentator states: Emperor Xiaowen reigned for twenty-three years without adding to the palaces, parks, carriages, horses, or furnishings.
units.literal: The commentator says: Emperor Xiaowen ascended the throne for twenty-three years, and the palaces, parks, carriages, horses, and furnishings were not increased at all.

units.zh: 高祖十一年，誅陳豨，定代地，立為代王，都中都。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, after executing Chen Xi and pacifying the Dai region, he was established as King of Dai with his capital at Zhongdu.
units.literal: In Gaozu's eleventh year, executed Chen Xi, pacified Dai territory, established as King of Dai, capital at Zhongdu.

units.zh: 皇帝即日夕入未央宮。
units.en: The emperor entered Weiyang Palace that same evening.
units.literal: That evening the emperor entered Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 遂即天子位。
units.en: He immediately ascended the imperial throne.
units.literal: He then immediately ascended the imperial throne.

units.zh: 七年夏六月己亥，帝崩于未央宮。
units.en: On the day Jihai in the sixth month of summer in the seventh year, the emperor passed away in Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: In the seventh year, summer, sixth month, day Jihai, the emperor died in Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 上曰： 「楚王，季父也，春秋高，閱天下之義理多矣，明於國家之體。
units.en: The emperor replied: 'The King of Chu is my uncle. Advanced in years and experienced in the world's moral principles, he understands the proper order of the state.
units.literal: The emperor said: 'The King of Chu is my uncle. He is advanced in age, has seen much of the world's principles and righteousness, understands the structure of the state.

units.zh: 吳王於朕，兄也；
units.en: The King of Wu is like an elder brother to me;
units.literal: The King of Wu is an elder brother to me;

units.zh: 淮南王，弟也：皆秉德以陪朕，豈為不豫哉！
units.en: The King of Huainan is like a younger brother to me. All of them uphold virtue to support me—how could they not stand ready as successors!
units.literal: The King of Huainan is my younger brother: all uphold virtue to assist me, how could they not be prepared!

units.zh: 子啟最長，敦厚慈仁，請建以為太子。」
units.en: Prince Qi is the eldest son, honest and sincere, kind and benevolent. We petition to establish him as crown prince.'
units.literal: Prince Qi is the eldest, honest, kind, and benevolent. We petition to establish him as crown prince.'

units.zh: 皇太后曰：「立太子母竇氏為皇后。」
units.en: The Empress Dowager declared: 'Establish Lady Dou, mother of the crown prince, as empress.'
units.literal: The Empress Dowager said: 'Establish the crown prince's mother Lady Dou as empress.'

units.zh: 因立皇子武為代王，參為太原王，揖為梁王。
units.en: As a result, he established his sons Wu as King of Dai, Can as King of Taiyuan, and Yi as King of Liang.
units.literal: Consequently he established the imperial princes Wu as King of Dai, Can as King of Taiyuan, and Yi as King of Liang.

units.zh: 身衣弋綈，所幸慎夫人衣不曳地，帷帳無文繡，以示敦朴，為天下先。
units.en: He himself wore coarse silk garments, and his favored Lady Shen's robes did not trail on the ground. The curtains and canopies lacked embroidered patterns, demonstrating frugality and setting an example for the world.
units.literal: He himself wore coarse silk, and the favored Lady Shen's robes did not drag on the ground; the curtains and canopies had no embroidered patterns, to demonstrate frugality and lead the world by example.

units.zh: 丞相陳平、太尉周勃、朱虛侯劉章等共誅之，謀立代王。
units.en: Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, the Marquis of Zhuxu Liu Zhang, and others joined together to execute the Lü clan and plotted to establish the King of Dai on the throne.
units.literal: Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, Marquis of Zhuxu Liu Zhang and others together executed them, plotted to establish the King of Dai.

units.zh: 大臣遂使人迎代王。
units.en: The ministers then dispatched envoys to welcome the King of Dai.
units.literal: The ministers then sent people to welcome the King of Dai.

units.zh: 今已誅諸呂，新喋血京師，以迎大王為名，實不可信。
units.en: Now that the Lü clan has been executed and the capital still runs with fresh blood, their claim of welcoming Your Majesty is utterly untrustworthy.
units.literal: Now that the Lü clan has been executed and the capital is fresh with blood, using the name of welcoming Your Majesty, it is truly not trustworthy.

units.zh: 願稱疾無往，以觀其變。」
units.en: We urge Your Majesty to feign illness and decline to go, so that we may observe how the situation develops.'
units.literal: We wish you would feign illness and not go, to observe how things change.'

units.zh: 方今高帝子獨淮南王與 大王，大王又長，賢聖仁孝，聞於天下，故大臣因天下之心而欲迎立大王，大王勿疑也。」
units.en: Of Emperor Gaozu's surviving sons, only the King of Huainan and Your Majesty remain. You are the elder brother, renowned throughout the empire for your virtue, wisdom, benevolence, and filial piety. The ministers, following the will of the people, wish to welcome you as emperor. Do not doubt this.'
units.literal: Nowadays among Gaozu's sons only the King of Huainan and Your Majesty remain. Your Majesty is also the eldest, virtuous, sage-like, benevolent and filial, renowned throughout the world. Therefore the ministers, following the will of the world, desire to welcome and establish Your Majesty. Your Majesty should not doubt this.'

units.zh: 代王報太后，計猶豫未定。
units.en: The King of Dai informed the Empress Dowager, but his plans remained uncertain and unresolved.
units.literal: The King of Dai reported to the Empress Dowager; his plans were hesitant and undecided.

units.zh: 代王曰：「寡人固已為王，又何王乎？」
units.en: The King of Dai replied: 'I am already a king—what greater kingship could there be?'
units.literal: The King of Dai said: 'I am already a king, what more kingship is there?'

units.zh: 卜人曰：「所謂天王者，乃天子也。」
units.en: The diviner explained: 'The heavenly king of which I speak is none other than the emperor himself.'
units.literal: The diviner said: 'What is called heavenly king is precisely the Son of Heaven.'

units.zh: 於是代王乃遣太后弟薄昭見太尉勃，勃等具言所以迎立王者。
units.en: At this the King of Dai dispatched Bo Zhao, the Empress Dowager's younger brother, to meet with Grand Commandant Zhou Bo. Zhou Bo and his colleagues explained in detail the reasons for welcoming and enthroning the king.
units.literal: Thereupon the King of Dai sent the Empress Dowager's younger brother Bo Zhao to see Grand Commandant Zhou Bo; Zhou Bo and the others fully explained the reasons for welcoming and establishing the king.

units.zh: 代王笑謂宋昌曰：「果如公言。」
units.en: The King of Dai smiled and told Song Chang: 'Just as you predicted.'
units.literal: The King of Dai smiled and said to Song Chang: 'Indeed as you said.'

units.zh: 昌還報，代王乃進至渭橋。
units.en: Song Chang returned with his report, and the King of Dai then proceeded to Wei Bridge.
units.literal: Chang returned and reported; the King of Dai then advanced to Wei Bridge.

units.zh: 群臣拜謁稱臣，代王下拜。
units.en: The assembled ministers bowed low and acknowledged him as their sovereign. The King of Dai returned the courtesy with a bow.
units.literal: The ministers bowed and paid respects, calling themselves subjects. The King of Dai descended and bowed.

units.zh: 代王謝曰：「至邸而議之。」
units.en: The King of Dai politely declined, saying: "Let us discuss this when we reach the residence."
units.literal: The King of Dai declined, saying: "Let us discuss it when we reach the residence."

units.zh: 群臣從至，上議曰：「丞相臣平、太尉臣勃、大將軍臣武、御史大夫臣蒼、宗正臣郢、朱虛侯臣章、東牟侯臣興居、典客臣揭再拜言大王足下：子弘等皆非孝惠皇帝子，不當奉宗廟。
units.en: The ministers followed and arrived. The court deliberated, saying: "Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, General-in-Chief Chai Wu, Grandee Secretary Zhang Cang, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Ying, Marquis Zhu Xu Liu Zhang, Marquis Dong Mou Liu Xingju, and Court Receptionist Liu Jie bowed twice and addressed Your Majesty: Zi Hong and the others are not sons of Emperor Xiaohui and should not serve at the ancestral temple.
units.literal: The ministers followed and arrived. The court deliberated, saying: "Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, General-in-Chief Chai Wu, Grandee Secretary Zhang Cang, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Ying, Marquis Zhu Xu Liu Zhang, Marquis Dong Mou Liu Xingju, and Court Receptionist Liu Jie bowed twice and addressed Your Majesty: Zi Hong and the others are not sons of Emperor Xiaohui and ought not serve at the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 臣謹請陰安侯、頃王后、琅邪王、列侯、吏二千石議，大王高皇帝子，宜為嗣。
units.en: We ministers respectfully requested deliberation by the Marquis of Yin'an, the queen dowager of King Qing, the King of Langye, the ranked marquises, and officials of two thousand shi. They agree that Your Majesty, as a son of Emperor Gao, should be the successor.
units.literal: We ministers respectfully request that the Marquis of Yin'an, the Queen Dowager of King Qing, the King of Langye, the ranked marquises, and officials of two thousand shi deliberate. Your Majesty is a son of Emperor Gao and should be the successor.

units.zh: 願大王即天子位。」
units.en: We wish Your Majesty to immediately ascend the imperial throne."
units.literal: We wish Your Majesty to immediately ascend the imperial throne."

units.zh: 代王曰：「奉高帝宗廟，重事也。
units.en: The King of Dai said: "Serving at Emperor Gao's ancestral temple is a grave matter.
units.literal: The King of Dai said: "Serving at Emperor Gao's ancestral temple is a grave matter.

units.zh: 代王西鄉讓者三，南鄉讓者再。
units.en: The King of Dai declined three times while facing west and twice while facing south.
units.literal: The King of Dai declined three times while facing west and twice while facing south.

units.zh: 丞相平等皆曰：「臣伏計之，大王奉高祖宗廟最宜稱，雖天下諸侯萬民皆以為宜。
units.en: Chancellor Ping and the others said: "We ministers have considered this carefully. Your Majesty is most fitting and worthy to serve at Emperor Gao's ancestral temple, and the feudal lords and people throughout the realm all agree.
units.literal: Chancellor Ping and the others all said: "We ministers have considered this carefully. Your Majesty is most fitting and worthy to serve at Emperor Gao's ancestral temple, and the feudal lords and myriad people throughout the realm all consider it fitting.

units.zh: 願大王幸聽臣等。
units.en: We beg Your Majesty to hear your ministers.
units.literal: May Your Majesty graciously hear your ministers.

units.zh: 代王曰：「宗室將相王列侯以為其宜寡人，寡人不敢辭。」
units.en: The King of Dai said: "The imperial clan, generals, chancellors, kings, and marquises all consider me the suitable one. I do not dare decline."
units.literal: The King of Dai said: "The imperial clan, generals, chancellors, kings, and marquises all consider me the suitable one. I do not dare decline."

units.zh: 元年冬十月辛亥，皇帝見于高廟。
units.en: On the xinhai day of the tenth month of winter in the first year, the emperor appeared at Gaozu's ancestral temple.
units.literal: On the xinhai day of the tenth month of winter in the first year, the emperor appeared at the Gao ancestral temple.

units.zh: 上乃許之。
units.en: The emperor then gave his approval.
units.literal: The emperor then consented.

units.zh: 乃脩代來功。
units.en: He then recompensed the merits earned during his time as King of Dai.
units.literal: He then rewarded the merits from the time in Dai.

units.zh: 上幸甘泉，遣丞相灌嬰擊匈奴，匈奴去。
units.en: The emperor journeyed to Ganquan and sent Chancellor Guan Ying to attack the Xiongnu invaders, who then retreated.
units.literal: The emperor traveled to Ganquan and dispatched Chancellor Guan Ying to attack the Xiongnu; the Xiongnu withdrew.

units.zh: 上自甘泉之高奴，因幸太原，見故群臣，皆賜之。
units.en: The emperor traveled from Ganquan to Gaonu, then proceeded to Taiyuan where he met his old ministers and bestowed gifts upon them all.
units.literal: The emperor went from Ganquan to Gaonu, and then proceeded to Taiyuan, where he met with his former ministers and granted gifts to all of them.

units.zh: 濟北王興居聞帝之代，欲自擊匈奴，乃反，發兵欲襲滎陽。
units.en: King Xingju of Jibei learned that the emperor was on his tour in Dai territory. He wanted to lead his own campaign against the Xiongnu, but instead he rebelled and mobilized troops to attack Xingyang.
units.literal: King Xingju of Jibei heard that the emperor was on his tour in Dai, desired to personally attack the Xiongnu, but instead rebelled, mobilizing troops to attack Xingyang.

units.zh: 秋七月，上自太原至長安。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, the emperor returned to Chang'an from Taiyuan.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, the emperor returned from Taiyuan to Chang'an.

units.zh: 春正月，上自代還。
units.en: In the first month of spring, the emperor returned from Dai.
units.literal: Spring, first month, the emperor returned from Dai.

units.zh: 上親勞軍，勒兵，申教令，賜吏卒。
units.en: The emperor personally inspected the troops, conducted military drills, reinforced the orders, and distributed rewards to the officers and soldiers.
units.literal: The emperor personally reviewed the troops, drilled the soldiers, reiterated the orders, and rewarded the officers and soldiers.

units.zh: 皇太后固要上，乃止。
units.en: The Empress Dowager firmly prevented the emperor from going, and so he abandoned the plan.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager firmly restrained the emperor, and so he stopped.

units.zh: 上乃下詔議郊祀。
units.en: The emperor then issued an edict calling for deliberation on suburban sacrifices.
units.literal: The emperor then issued an edict to deliberate on the suburban sacrifices.

units.zh: 夏四月，上幸雍，始郊見五帝，赦天下，修名山大川嘗祀而絕者，有司以歲時致禮。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, the emperor traveled to Yong and began the suburban sacrifices to the Five Emperors. He granted amnesty to the entire empire and restored the seasonal sacrifices to famous mountains and great rivers that had lapsed, with officials performing the rites at the proper times.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month: The emperor traveled to Yong, began the suburban sacrifices to meet the Five Emperors, granted amnesty to the world, and restored the seasonal sacrifices to famous mountains and great rivers that had been discontinued, with the officials performing the rites at the appropriate times.

units.zh: 九月，詔諸侯王公卿郡守舉賢良能直言極諫者，上親策之，傅納以言。
units.en: In the ninth month, he commanded feudal lords, nobles, ministers, and commandery governors to recommend worthy individuals capable of speaking frankly and offering bold criticism. The emperor personally examined them and accepted their counsel.
units.literal: Ninth month: He commanded the feudal lords, nobles, ministers, and commandery governors to recommend worthy and good men capable of speaking directly and offering extreme remonstrance; the emperor personally examined them and accepted their words.

units.zh: 十六年夏四月，上郊祀五帝于渭陽。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the sixteenth year, the emperor performed suburban sacrifices to the Five Emperors at Weiyang.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, summer, fourth month, the emperor performed suburban sacrifices to the Five Emperors at Wei Yang.

units.zh: 上曰：「百金，中人十家之產也。
units.en: The emperor said: 'One hundred jin represents the combined wealth of ten middle-class families.
units.literal: The emperor said: 'One hundred jin is the property of ten middle-class families.

units.zh: 南越尉佗自立為帝，召貴佗兄弟，以德懷之，佗遂稱臣。
units.en: Wei Tuo of Nanyue proclaimed himself emperor. The emperor summoned and honored Tuo's brothers, winning Tuo over with virtuous conduct, whereupon Tuo submitted as a vassal.
units.literal: Nanyue's Wei Tuo established himself as emperor; he summoned and honored Tuo's brothers, and won Tuo over with virtue, whereupon Tuo submitted as a vassal.

units.zh: 吳王詐病不朝，賜以几杖。
units.en: The King of Wu feigned illness and failed to attend court. The emperor granted him a table and staff as symbols of his advanced age.
units.literal: King of Wu feigned illness and did not attend court; he granted him a table and staff.

units.zh: 張武等受賂金錢，覺，更加賞賜，以媿其心。
units.en: Zhang Wu and others accepted bribes of gold and cash. When this was discovered, the emperor instead increased their rewards to shame their consciences.
units.literal: Zhang Wu and others accepted bribes of gold and cash; when discovered, he instead increased their rewards to shame their hearts.

units.zh: 溉，〔一〕時梁州刺史陰子春、領軍朱异在焉。
units.en: Collation variant: (Gai), [1] At that time Liang inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and director of the palace guard Zhu Yi were present.
units.literal: Collation variant: (Gai), At that time Liang Inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and Director of the Palace Guard Zhu Yi were present.

units.zh: 子春素知申，即於坐所呼與為對，〔二〕申每有妙思，异觀而奇之，因引申遊處。
units.en: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, [2] Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.
units.literal: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.

units.zh: 夫種、蠡無一罪，身死亡；
units.en: Wen Zhong and Fan Li had committed no such crimes, yet they still perished.
units.literal: Wen Zhong and Fan Li committed no such crimes, yet they died.

units.zh: 雄桀之士因勢輔時，作為權詐以相傾覆，吳有孫武，齊有孫臏，魏有吳起，秦有商鞅，皆禽敵立勝，垂著篇籍。
units.en: Strategists such as Sun Wu, Sun Bin, Wu Qi, and Shang Yang turned military thought toward power and deception, with influential textual legacies.
units.literal: Heroic and ruthless men, taking advantage of the age, made power techniques and deception to overturn one another: Wu had Sun Wu, Qi had Sun Bin, Wei had Wu Qi, Qin had Shang Yang-all captured enemies and secured victories, leaving written works.

units.zh: 世方爭於功利，而馳說者以孫、吳為宗。
units.en: With utility dominant, military discourse canonized the Sun-Wu tradition.
units.literal: As the age contended over profit and utility, persuasive theorists took Sun and Wu as their lineage.

units.zh: 時唯孫卿明於王道，而非之曰：「彼孫、吳者，上勢利而貴變詐；
units.en: Only Xunzi was clear on the kingly way and criticized them, saying: 'Those Sun and Wu strategists esteem advantage and prize changing deception;
units.literal: Only Xunzi was clear on the kingly way and criticized them, saying: 'Those Sun and Wu strategists esteem advantage and prize changing deception;

units.zh: 孫、吳、商、白之徒，皆身誅戮於前，而功滅亡於後。
units.en: The lineages of Sunzi, Wuzi, Shang Yang, and Bai Qi ended in violent ruin, and their victories did not endure.
units.literal: Followers of Sun, Wu, Shang, and Bai were all themselves executed in front, and their achievements perished afterward.

units.zh: 世宗文襄皇帝，諱澄，字子惠，神武長子也，母曰婁太后。
units.en: Emperor Wenxiang, temple name Shizong of Northern Qi, bore the personal name Cheng and the style Zihui. He was the eldest son of Gao Huan; his mother was Empress Dowager Lou.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong Wenxiang, taboo name Cheng, style Zihui, was the eldest son of Shenwu; his mother was Empress Dowager Lou.

units.zh: 王嘗侍飲，舉大觴曰：「臣澄勸陛下酒。」
units.en: Once, while attending him at drink, Gao Cheng raised a great goblet and said, "Your servant Cheng urges Your Majesty to drink."
units.literal: Once, while attending him at drink, the Prince raised a great goblet and said: "Your servant Cheng urges Your Majesty to drink."

units.zh: 齊受禪，追諡為文襄皇帝，廟號世宗。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, he was posthumously titled Emperor Wenxiang, with the temple name Shizong.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, he was posthumously titled Emperor Wenxiang, temple name Shizong.

units.zh: 七月戊戌，魏帝詔以文襄為使持節、大丞相、都督中外諸軍、錄尚書事、大行臺、渤海王。
units.en: In the seventh month, on wuxu day, the Eastern Wei emperor issued an edict that Gao Cheng be Bearer of Credentials, Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Prince of Bohai.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on wuxu, the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Wenxiang be Bearer of Credentials, Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Prince of Bohai.

units.zh: 魏中興元年，立為渤海王世子。
units.en: In Zhongxing 1 (531) he was made heir to the Prince of Bohai.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing of Wei he was established as heir of the Prince of Bohai.

units.zh: 三年，入輔朝政，加領左右、京畿大都督。
units.en: In the third year he entered the capital to assist in governance and was given charge of the Left and Right and made Grand Commander of the Capital Region.
units.literal: In the third year he entered to assist court governance and was given charge of the Left and Right and Grand Commander of the Capital Region.

units.zh: 興和二年，加大將軍，領中書監，仍攝吏部尚書。
units.en: In Xinghe 2 (540) he was made Grand General and Director of the Secretariat Supervisor while still serving as acting Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: In the second year of Xinghe he was given Grand General, Director of the Secretariat Supervisor, and still acted as Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 魏帝詔曰：「旣朝野攸憑，安危所系，不得令遂本懷，須有權奪，可復前大將軍，餘如故。」
units.en: The emperor issued an edict, "Since court and countryside rely on you and safety hangs upon you, I cannot let you follow your wish; authority must be taken by necessity. You may resume your former rank of Grand General; the rest remains as before."
units.literal: The Wei Emperor issued an edict: "Since court and countryside rely on you and safety hangs upon you, I cannot let you follow your original wish; there must be a taking of authority by necessity. You may resume your former rank of Grand General; the rest remains as before."

units.zh: 元象元年，攝吏部尚書。
units.en: In Yuanxiang 1 (538) he served as acting Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang he acted as Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 選人常以年勞為制，文襄乃釐改前式，銓擢唯在得人。
units.en: appointments had been governed by seniority; Gao Cheng reformed the old practice so that selection rested only on finding the right men.
units.literal: appointments had been governed by years of service; Wenxiang then reformed the former practice, and selection and promotion rested only on getting the right men.

units.zh: 二年，加侍中、開府儀同三司，尚孝靜帝妹馮翊長公主，時年十二，神情儁爽，便若成人。
units.en: In the second year he was made Palace Attendant and Grand Lord Equal to Three Imperator and married Princess Chang of Fengyi, Emperor Xiaojing's sister. He was twelve, handsome and spirited, already bearing himself like a man.
units.literal: In the second year he was given Palace Attendant, Grand Lord Equal to Three Imperator, and married the Princess Chang of Fengyi, sister of Emperor Xiaojing; he was then twelve, with a handsome and spirited bearing, already like a grown man.

units.zh: 壬寅，魏帝詔太原公洋攝理軍國，遣中使敦喻。
units.en: On renyin day the emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang administer military and state affairs and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.
units.literal: On renyin the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Yang administer military and state affairs, and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.

units.zh: 時王居北城東柏堂蒞政，以寵琅邪公主，欲其來往無所避忌，所有侍衛，皆出於外。
units.en: At the time Gao Cheng held court at the East Cypress Hall in the North City; favoring the Princess of Langye, he wished her comings and goings to be without restraint, and had all guards posted outside.
units.literal: At the time the Prince held court at the East Cypress Hall in the North City; favoring the Princess of Langye, he wished her comings and goings to be without restraint, and had all guards posted outside.

units.zh: 就杜詢講學，敏悟過人，詢甚嘆服。
units.en: He studied under Du Xun; his quickness of mind surpassed all others, and Du Xun came to admire him deeply.
units.literal: He went to Du Xun to study; his quick comprehension surpassed others, and Xun greatly admired him.

units.zh: 天平元年，加使持節、尚書令、大行臺、幷州刺史。
units.en: In Tianping 1 (534) he received Bearer of Credentials, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and the inspectorship of Bing Province.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianping he was given Bearer of Credentials, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Inspector of Bing Province.

units.zh: 辛卯，王遇盜而殂，時年二十九。
units.en: On xinmao Gao Cheng fell to assassins and died; he was twenty-nine.
units.literal: On xinmao the Prince fell to assassins and died; he was twenty-nine.

units.zh: 賊黨去床，因而見殺。
units.en: The assassins dragged him from the bed and killed him.
units.literal: The assassins dragged him from the bed and so he was killed.

units.zh: 葬于峻成陵。
units.en: He was buried at Juncheng Tomb.
units.literal: He was buried at Juncheng Tomb.

units.zh: 王以為信然，謂可誘而致，乃遺景書曰：
units.en: Gao Cheng believed it and thought he could be lured back; he sent Hou Jing a letter saying,
units.literal: The Prince believed it true and thought he could be lured back; he sent Jing a letter saying:

units.zh: 先王與司徒契闊夷險，孤子相依，偏所眷屬，義貫終始，情存歲寒。
units.en: The late king and the Minister of Works shared hardship through peril and isolation; I, his orphan, depended on you—you were his special charge. Righteousness ran from first to last; affection endured through the cold years.
units.literal: The late king and the Minister of Works shared hardship through peril and isolation; I, his orphan, depended on you — you were his special charge. Righteousness ran from first to last; affection endured through the cold years.

units.zh: 待為國士者乃立漆身之節，饋以一餐者便致扶輪之效，況其重於此乎？
units.en: Those treated as men of the state would lay down their lives; one who was fed a single meal would repay with the deed of bracing the wheel—how much more when the bond was weightier than this?
units.literal: Those treated as men of the state would lay down their lives; one who was fed a single meal would repay with the deed of bracing the wheel — how much more when the bond was weightier than this?

units.zh: 常以故舊之義，欲將子孫相托，方為秦晉之匹，共成劉、范之親。
units.en: By the old friendship I ever meant to entrust my descendants to you and make a match like Qin and Jin, forming a kinship like Liu and Fan.
units.literal: By the old friendship I ever meant to entrust my descendants to you and make a match like Qin and Jin, forming a kinship like Liu and Fan.

units.zh: 況聞負杖行歌，便以狼顧反噬，不蹈忠臣之路，便陷叛人之地。
units.en: Yet I hear that leaning on your staff and singing in the lanes, you turned like a wolf to bite in return, forsook the path of the loyal minister, and fell into the land of the rebel.
units.literal: Yet I hear that leaning on your staff and singing in the lanes, you turned like a wolf to bite in return, forsook the path of the loyal minister, and fell into the land of the rebel.

units.zh: 力不足以自強，勢不足以自保，率烏合之衆，為累卵之危。
units.en: Your strength is not enough to strengthen yourself; your power is not enough to protect yourself; you lead a rabble host and stand in peril like a pile of eggs.
units.literal: Your strength is not enough to strengthen yourself; your power is not enough to protect yourself; you lead a rabble host and stand in peril like a pile of eggs.

units.zh: 西取救於宇文，南請援於蕭氏，以狐疑之心，為首鼠之事。
units.en: West you seek rescue from Yuwen; south you ask aid from the Xiao house—with a doubting heart you do the deed of a wavering rat.
units.literal: West you seek rescue from Yuwen; south you ask aid from the Xiao house — with a doubting heart you do the deed of a wavering rat.

units.zh: 入秦則秦人不容，歸吳則吳人不信。
units.en: Enter Qin and the men of Qin will not receive you; return to Wu and the men of Wu will not trust you.
units.literal: Enter Qin and the men of Qin will not receive you; return to Wu and the men of Wu will not trust you.

units.zh: 當是不逞之人，曲為無端之說，遂懷市虎之疑，乃致投杼之惑。
units.en: Surely it was men of disorder who twisted groundless words, so that you harbored the suspicion of the tiger in the market and fell into the confusion of the thrown shuttle.
units.literal: Surely it was men of disorder who twisted groundless words, so that you harbored the suspicion of the tiger in the market and fell into the confusion of the thrown shuttle.

units.zh: 比來舉止，事已可見，人相疑誤，想自覺知。
units.en: Your conduct of late is already plain to see; men suspect and err, and I think you know it yourself.
units.literal: Your conduct of late is already plain to see; men suspect and err, and I think you know it yourself.

units.zh: 闔門大小，悉在司寇，意謂李氏未滅，猶言少卿可反。
units.en: Your whole household, great and small, is in the hands of the Minister of Justice; I thought that since the Li clan was not yet destroyed, one might still say the Lesser Minister could return.
units.literal: Your whole household, great and small, is in the hands of the Minister of Justice; I thought that since the Li clan was not yet destroyed, one might still say the Lesser Minister could return.

units.zh: 孤子無狀招禍，丁天酷罰，但禮由權奪，志在忘私，聊遣偏裨，前驅致討，南兗、揚州，應時剋復。
units.en: I, the orphan, unworthy, have drawn calamity; heaven has dealt a cruel punishment—yet ritual allows taking authority by necessity, and my aim is to forget private feeling. I have sent only a partial force as vanguard to attack; southern Yanzhou and Yangzhou were recovered at once.
units.literal: I, the orphan, unworthy, have drawn calamity; heaven has dealt a cruel punishment — yet ritual allows taking authority by necessity, and my aim is to forget private feeling. I have sent only a partial force as vanguard to attack; southern Yanzhou and Yangzhou were recovered at once.

units.zh: 即欲乘機，席捲縣瓠，屬以炎暑，欲為後圖，且令還師，待時更舉。
units.en: I meant to seize the moment and sweep up Xiangcheng, but because of the heat I planned for later and for now ordered withdrawal, to strike again when the time comes.
units.literal: I meant to seize the moment, sweep up Xiangcheng, but because of the heat I planned for later and for now ordered withdrawal, to strike again when the time comes.

units.zh: 今寒膠向折，白露將團，方憑國靈，龔行天罰。
units.en: Now the cold glue is about to break and white dew will soon gather; relying on the state's numen, I march to execute heaven's punishment.
units.literal: Now the cold glue is about to break and white dew will soon gather; relying on the state's numen, I march to execute heaven's punishment.

units.zh: 器械精新，士馬強盛，內外感恩，上下戮力，三令五申，可赴湯火。
units.en: Weapons are sharp and new, soldiers and horses strong; within and without men are grateful, above and below strive together; thrice and five times commanded, they would walk into boiling water.
units.literal: Weapons are sharp and new, soldiers and horses strong; within and without men are grateful, above and below strive together; thrice and five times commanded, they would walk into boiling water.

units.zh: 使旗鼓相望，埃塵相接，勢如沃雪，事等注熒。
units.en: Banners and drums face each other, dust and smoke meet; the force is like pouring water on snow, the affair like pouring oil on flame.
units.literal: Banners and drums face each other, dust and smoke meet; the force is like pouring water on snow, the affair like pouring oil on flame.

units.zh: 夫明者去危就安，智者轉禍為福，甯人負我，不我負人，當開從善之途，使有改迷之路。
units.en: The clear-sighted leave peril for safety; the wise turn calamity into blessing. Better that others wrong me than that I wrong others—open the path of accepting good, and give a road for correcting error.
units.literal: The clear-sighted leave peril for safety; the wise turn calamity into blessing. Better that others wrong me than that I wrong others — open the path of accepting good, and give a road for correcting error.

units.zh: 若能卷甲來朝，垂橐還闕者，即當授豫州，必使終君身世。
units.en: If you can roll up your armor and come to court, empty your bags and return to the capital, I will at once grant you Yuzhou and see that you hold it for life.
units.literal: If you can roll up your armor and come to court, empty your bags and return to the capital, I will at once grant you Yuzhou and see that you hold it for life.

units.zh: 所部文武更不追攝，進得保其祿位，退則不喪功名。
units.en: Your civil and military subordinates will not be pursued; advance and you keep rank and salary, retreat and you lose neither merit nor fame.
units.literal: Your civil and military subordinates will not be pursued; advance and you keep rank and salary, retreat and you lose neither merit nor fame.

units.zh: 今王思政等皆孤軍偏將，遠來深入，然其性命在君掌握，脫能刺之，想有餘力。
units.en: Now Wang Sizheng and the rest are isolated generals who came from afar and marched deep; yet their lives are in your hand—if you can stab them, I think you still have strength enough.
units.literal: Now Wang Sizheng and the rest are isolated generals who came from afar and marched deep; yet their lives are in your hand — if you can stab them, I think you still have strength enough.

units.zh: 節相加授，永保疆埸。
units.en: I will add the seal of minister and forever secure the frontier.
units.literal: I will add the seal of minister and forever secure the frontier.

units.zh: 君門眷屬，可以無患，寵妻愛子，亦送相還，仍為通家，共成親好。
units.en: Your household kin need not fear; your cherished wife and beloved sons I will also send back—we shall again be allied houses and form a close bond.
units.literal: Your household kin need not fear; your cherished wife and beloved sons I will also send back — we shall again be allied houses and form a close bond.

units.zh: 君今不能東封函谷，南面稱孤，受制於人，威名頓盡。
units.en: If you cannot now seal Hangu Pass in the east and call yourself king facing south, but must be controlled by others, your renown will at once be spent.
units.literal: If you cannot now seal Hangu Pass in the east and call yourself king facing south, but must be controlled by others, your renown will at once be spent.

units.zh: 得地不欲自守，聚衆不以為強，空使身有背叛之名，家有惡逆之禍，覆宗絕嗣，自貽伊戚。
units.en: You gain land yet will not hold it yourself; you gather a host yet do not count it strong—in vain you bear the name of rebel and your house the calamity of treason; clan extinguished, line cut off, you bring sorrow on yourself.
units.literal: You gain land yet will not hold it yourself; you gather a host yet do not count it strong — in vain you bear the name of rebel and your house the calamity of treason; clan extinguished, line cut off, you bring sorrow on yourself.

units.zh: 戴天履地，能無愧乎！
units.en: Wearing heaven on your head and treading earth underfoot—can you be without shame!
units.literal: Wearing heaven on your head and treading earth underfoot — can you be without shame!

units.zh: 孤子今日不應遣此，但見蔡遵道云：「司徒本無西歸之心，深有悔過之意」，未知此語為虛為實。
units.en: I, the orphan, ought not to send this today, but I saw Cai Zundao say, "The Minister of Works originally had no mind to go west and deeply wished to repent"—I do not know whether these words are empty or real.
units.literal: I, the orphan, ought not to send this today, but I saw Cai Zundao say: "The Minister of Works originally had no mind to go west and deeply wished to repent" — I do not know whether these words are empty or real.

units.zh: 吉凶之理，想自圖之。
units.en: The logic of fortune and calamity—I think you will weigh it yourself.
units.literal: The logic of fortune and calamity — I think you will weigh it yourself.

units.zh: 論曰：文襄嗣膺霸道，威略昭著。
units.en: The appraisal says: Wenxiang inherited the hegemonic enterprise, and his power and strategy were unmistakable.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Wenxiang succeeded to the hegemonic enterprise, and his martial strategy was plainly displayed.

units.zh: 而志在峻法，急於禦下，於前王之德，有所未同。
units.en: Yet he set his mind on harsh law and was impatient in ruling those below him; in this he fell short of the former king's virtue.
units.literal: Yet his intent lay in severe laws and he was harsh in governing subordinates; in the virtue of the former king, there was something with which he did not accord.

units.zh: 生而岐嶷，神武異之。
units.en: From birth he was precocious and keen; Gao Huan took him for a prodigy.
units.literal: From birth he was precocious and sharp; Shenwu regarded him as extraordinary.

units.zh: 武定四年十一月，神武西討，不豫班師，文襄馳赴軍所，侍衛還晉陽。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Wuding 4 (546), Gao Huan marched west, fell ill, and withdrew; Gao Cheng raced to the army, attended him, and escorted him back to Jinyang.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Wuding, Shenwu campaigned west and, falling ill, withdrew the army; Wenxiang raced to the army's camp, attended him, and escorted him back to Jinyang.

units.zh: 五年正月丙午，神武崩，秘不發喪。
units.en: In the first month of Wuding 5 (547), on bingwu day, Gao Huan died; the death was kept secret.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on bingwu, Shenwu died; the death was kept secret.

units.zh: 夏四月壬申，文襄朝於鄴。
units.en: In the fourth month, on renshen day, Gao Cheng attended court at Ye.
units.literal: In the fourth month, on renshen, Wenxiang attended court at Ye.

units.zh: 秘不發喪，徐出言曰：「奴反，大將軍被傷，無大苦也。」
units.en: They kept the death secret, then slowly announced, "The slave rebelled; the Grand General was wounded—nothing grave."
units.literal: They kept the death secret, then slowly announced: "The slave rebelled; the Grand General was wounded—nothing grave."

units.zh: 文襄乃奏吏部郎崔暹為御史中尉，糾劾權豪，無所縱捨，於是風俗更始，私枉路絕。
units.en: Gao Cheng then had Cui Xian of the Ministry of Personnel appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief; he impeached the powerful without sparing any, custom was renewed, and private wrongdoing and bribery ceased.
units.literal: Wenxiang then memorialized to make Cui Xuan of the Ministry of Personnel Vice Censor-in-Chief; he impeached the powerful and wealthy without sparing any, and custom was renewed — private wrongdoing and bribery ceased.

units.zh: 遣司空韓軌率衆討之。
units.en: Gao Cheng sent Minister of Works Han Gui at the head of an army to attack him.
units.literal: He sent Minister of Works Han Gui at the head of an army to attack him.

units.zh: 丁丑，文襄還晉陽，乃發喪，告喻文武，陳神武遺志。
units.en: On dingchou day Gao Cheng returned to Jinyang, announced the death, informed civil and military officials, and set forth Gao Huan's final wishes.
units.literal: On dingchou Wenxiang returned to Jinyang, then announced the death, informed civil and military officials, and set forth Shenwu's final wishes.

units.zh: 文襄啟辭位，願停王爵。
units.en: Gao Cheng memorialized to decline and wished to relinquish the princely rank.
units.literal: Wenxiang memorialized to decline the post and wished to relinquish the princely rank.

units.zh: 八月戊辰，文襄啟申神武遺令，請減國邑分封將督，各有差。
units.en: In the eighth month, on wuchen day, Gao Cheng memorialized to carry out Gao Huan's final command, asking to reduce the royal fief and enfeoff generals and commanders, each according to rank.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on wuchen, Wenxiang memorialized to carry out Shenwu's final command, asking to reduce the fiefs of the realm and enfeoff generals and commanders, each according to rank.

units.zh: 王尋覽書，問誰為作。
units.en: When Gao Cheng had read the letter, he asked who had written it.
units.literal: When the Prince had read the letter, he asked who had written it.

units.zh: 王曰：「偉才如此，何因不使我知？」
units.en: Gao Cheng said, "With talent like this, why was I not told?"
units.literal: The Prince said: "With talent like this, why was I not told?"

units.zh: 王欲間景於梁，又與景書而謬其辭，云本使景陽叛，欲與圖西，西人知之，故景更與圖南為事。
units.en: Gao Cheng wished to drive a wedge between Hou Jing and Liang, and wrote to Jing with falsified wording, saying he had originally sent Jing to stir rebellion at Jingyang and meant to plot the west together; when Western Wei learned of it, Jing turned instead to plotting with the south.
units.literal: The Prince wished to drive a wedge between Jing and Liang, and wrote to Jing with falsified wording, saying he had originally had Jing stir rebellion at Jingyang and planned with him to strike west; when Western Wei learned this, Jing turned instead to scheming with the south.

units.zh: 壬申，東魏主與王獵於鄴東，馳逐如飛。
units.en: On renshen the Eastern Wei emperor hunted with Gao Cheng east of Ye, galloping as if in flight.
units.literal: On renshen, the Eastern Wei emperor hunted with the Prince east of Ye, racing as if flying.

units.zh: 監衛都督烏那羅受工伐從後呼曰：「天子莫走馬，大將軍怒。」
units.en: Supervisory Guard Commander Wunaluo Shougongfa shouted from behind, "Your Majesty, do not gallop—the Grand General will be angry!"
units.literal: Supervisory Guard Commander Wunaluo Shougongfa shouted from behind: "Your Majesty, do not gallop—the Grand General will be angry!"

units.zh: 王怒曰：「朕！
units.en: Gao Cheng raged, "Imperial We!
units.literal: The Prince raged: "Imperial We!

units.zh: 東魏主賜季舒彩，季舒未敢即受，啟之於王，王使取一段。
units.en: The Eastern Wei emperor bestowed silk on Jishu; Jishu dared not accept at once and reported to Gao Cheng, who told him to take one bolt.
units.literal: The Eastern Wei emperor bestowed silk on Jishu; Jishu dared not accept at once and reported to the Prince, who told him to take one bolt.

units.zh: 三月辛亥，王南臨黎陽，濟於虎牢，自洛陽從太行而反晉陽。
units.en: On xinhai of the third month Gao Cheng went south to Liyang, crossed at Hulao, and returned to Jinyang from Luoyang by way of the Taihang.
units.literal: On xinhai of the third month, the Prince went south to Liyang, crossed at Hulao, and returned to Jinyang by way of Taihang from Luoyang.

units.zh: 六月，王巡北邊城戍，賑賜有差。
units.en: In the sixth month Gao Cheng toured the northern border forts and gave relief in varying measure.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Prince toured northern border forts and gave relief in varying measure.

units.zh: 七月，王還晉陽。
units.en: In the seventh month Gao Cheng returned to Jinyang.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Prince returned to Jinyang.

units.zh: 識者以為王將殂之兆也。
units.en: Those who understood took it as an omen that Gao Cheng would die.
units.literal: Those who understood took it as an omen that the Prince would die.

units.zh: 初，梁將蘭欽子京為東魏所虜，王命以配廚。
units.en: Earlier, Zi Jing, son of the Liang general Lan Qin, had been captured by Eastern Wei; Gao Cheng ordered him assigned to the kitchen staff.
units.literal: Earlier, Zi Jing, son of Liang General Lan Qin, had been captured by Eastern Wei; the Prince ordered him assigned to the kitchen staff.

units.zh: 欽請贖之，王不許。
units.en: Lan Qin asked to ransom him; Gao Cheng refused.
units.literal: Lan Qin asked to ransom him; the Prince refused.

units.zh: 京再訴，王使監廚蒼頭薛豐洛杖之，曰：「更訴當殺爾。」
units.en: Jing appealed again; Gao Cheng had the kitchen-overseer bondman Xue Fengluo beat him and said, "Complain again and you will be killed."
units.literal: Jing appealed again; the Prince had kitchen-overseer bondman Xue Fengluo beat him and said: "Complain again and you will be killed."

units.zh: 王曰：「小人新杖之，故嚇我耳。」
units.en: Gao Cheng said, "That wretch was just flogged—he only wants to frighten me."
units.literal: The Prince said: "That wretch was just flogged—he only wants to frighten me."

units.zh: 京將進食，王却，謂諸人曰：「昨夜夢此奴斫我，宜殺却。」
units.en: When Jing was about to bring food, Gao Cheng held back and told the others, "Last night I dreamed this slave hacked at me—I ought to kill him."
units.literal: When Jing was about to bring food, the Prince held back and told the others: "Last night I dreamed this slave hacked at me—I ought to kill him."

units.zh: 王怒曰：「我未索食，爾何據來！」
units.en: Gao Cheng raged, "I did not ask for food—why do you press in!"
units.literal: The Prince raged: "I did not ask for food—why do you press in!"

units.zh: 王自投傷足，入于床下。
units.en: Gao Cheng threw himself aside, wounded in the foot, and crawled under the bed.
units.literal: The Prince threw himself aside, wounded in the foot, and crawled under the bed.

units.zh: 然文襄之禍生所忽，蓋有由焉。
units.en: Yet Wenxiang's disaster grew out of what he neglected; it had its cause.
units.literal: Yet Wenxiang's disaster arose from what he neglected; there was surely a cause for it.
